subject.title: fix(skills): pass ownerHandle in ClawHub bulk verdict targets to resolve ambiguous slugs

question: Should this bug be fixed by coordinating an owner-aware ClawHub bulk contract, or by adding an OpenClaw fallback to owner-qualified single-skill verification?
rationale: The submitted payload-only change cannot fix the current endpoint behavior, while choosing a fallback affects request fan-out and cross-repository ownership.

options.title: Coordinate bulk contract
options.body: Add and deploy owner-aware bulk resolution in ClawHub, then merge the matching OpenClaw request and regression coverage together.

options.title: Add bounded fallback
options.body: When an owner-qualified bulk item returns not found, call the existing owner-qualified single-verification path with explicit limits and tests.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this branch until a canonical cross-repository implementation is ready.

recommendation.title: Coordinate bulk contract
recommendation.body: Add and deploy owner-aware bulk resolution in ClawHub, then merge the matching OpenClaw request and regression coverage together.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work introduced the ClawHub skill verification and trust surfaces affected by this API decision.
